mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% (FEDFUNDS <= 3.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The current FEDFUNDS of 2.98% meets this condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market conditions (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with slowing industrial production (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% in last month) signal an economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE>5.0% AND INDPRO growth<0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215.0) signal impending monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL>215.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO growth rate < 0.0% in last month) signals weakening economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO growth < 0.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1000.0) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The current HOUST of 1012.0 meets this condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < 0.5% in last month) signals weak consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS growth < 0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < 0.5% in last month) combined with low housing starts (HOUST < 1000.0) signals a weak consumer demand environment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS growth<0.5% AND HOUST<1000.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
